about: Hand-labelled intent cases for IntentRouter. Written before the current rules, from how employees actually phrase HR requests, then split deterministically into dev and report halves by index. Rules were tuned against the dev half only; the report half is the honest number. Do not move a case between splits to make a number look better -- add new cases instead.
split_rule: even index -> dev, odd index -> report
